text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant, pant...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(I can feel the wind embracing me,<n>and the world
looks so... beautiful.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I... I did it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (So this is what it feels like to finish a<n>G1!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I did it... I ran in a G1!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'm so happy...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (This means I can actually take on the<n>Triple Tiara!)

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I found myself absolutely<n>mesmerized by your
every stride!<n>Nice going!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Pearl...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Getting to compete against you has<n>made me, well...
more confident in<n>myself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Oooh! My heart!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Only fate knows if our paths will ever<n>cross again,
but... at least let me say<n>this.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Limitless potential lights our path<n>forward!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Mejiro Dober. I'll see<n>you again
someday.

text_block_list.name: Female Spectator
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Mejiro Dober is so cool!

text_block_list.name: Male Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Did we just witness the birth of a<n>new Mejiro
star?! I'll have to keep<n>my eye on her during the
Tiara tour!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I wouldn't expect anything<n>less from Dober.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober comes back wearing a<n>very satisfied
expression, the crowd<n>still cheering loudly in her
wake.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: What are you surprised about? I toldyou I wanted to do well today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I did say I wanted to do well... and I<n>guess I wasn't
all talk.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Trainer... I think I'm ready to take on<n>the next race.
choice_data_list: You mean the Oka Sho? Yeah, let's win it.
You mean the Oka Sho? Yeah, let's win it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Trainer... I think I'm ready to take on<n>the next race.
choice_data_list: You mean the Oka Sho? Yeah, let's win it.
You mean the Oka Sho? Yeah, let's win it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
As if there's any other option. I have<n>to win and
keep my promise with<n>Bright!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Right. I have to keep my promise with<n>Bright, which
means I've got to win!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: And in order for me to do that, well...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: And I'll be counting on your help, so...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'll see you tomorrow. For training.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Let's get back to training tomorrow,<n>okay?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It seems this race has given her the<n>tangible results
she needed going into<n>the Triple Tiara tour!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It seems this race has given her the<n>tangible results
she needed going into<n>the Triple Tiara tour!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Our next challenge is going to be a<n>Classic race—the
Oka Sho!
